description: Nevada Leaders Back Whipple’s Nevada First Vision for NV-04 HIKO, NV – Cody K Whipple, Republican candidate for Nevada’s 4th Congressional District, today announced the endorsement of Jacob D. “Jay” Bingham, who praised Whipple’s commitment to putting Nevada families, businesses, and communities first.
